Container.Name: kinora
Container.Overview: Kinora is a lightweight self-hosted media server: scans your movies and TV, fetches artwork from TMDB, and streams to any browser with hardware transcoding (Intel, AMD, NVIDIA). For NVIDIA, install the Nvidia Driver plugin and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media. Add libraries from /media in Admin → Libraries.

Config.Name: Transcode temp
Config.Description: Temporary transcode files. /tmp on Unraid is RAM, which is ideal.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: Hardware transcoding on Intel or AMD. Clear this if you have no iGPU/AMD GPU.

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional. Free from themoviedb.org. Can also be set later in Admin → Modules.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: With the Nvidia Driver plugin: 'all' or a GPU UUID. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.
